name: release
description: Write release notes, prepare changelogs, and cut releases through publication

interface.shortDescription: Write release notes and cut releases
interface.longDescription: Write a change's release note into its pull request and each affected project's changelog, or prepare a release entry from the notes its changes declare. Cut a release using .releasetools.yaml: check prerequisites, prepare the changelog, bump the version, open and merge the pull request, verify the merged commit, and publish by tag or workflow dispatch. Each release step stops at the first refusal.
capabilities: Write a change's note into its pull request and changelog
Prepare a release's changelog from the notes its changes declare
Run a release's steps in order, stopping at the first refusal
Bump the version with the command the project declares
Publish only a commit whose checks already passed, by tag or by dispatch
Declare how a repository publishes and make its workflow match
defaultPrompt: Write the release note for this change.
Ship 0.4.0 and wait for it to publish.
